author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
**Verdict: PolicyEngine adjustment.**

Confirmed — PE has the $90,000 cutoff in its percentage table but keys the lookup on taxable income (line 38, $80,306 here) instead of net income (line 26, $97,059), so it lands in the 30% band and pays $406.01. The 2021 Expanded Instructions worksheet (p. 86) keys line 2 on "total of line 26 of the IA 1040, columns A and B" with "$90,000 and over: not eligible for credit" — matching your TaxAct worksheet and [r. 701-304.15](https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/iowa/Iowa-Code-r-701-304.15). Without the credit PE is $4,719.40 vs your $4,721. Tracked in PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#9140.
